method: TypeScript AST of all tracked web src and package TS/JS/Vue scripts; API names and relative module import reverse closure. Backend manifest is authority entrypoint inventory, not AST reachability.
limitations: Vue template expressions are not AST-parsed; injected callbacks, runtime-generated intents, namespace aliases and external packages require manual tracing.
Module reverse closure is an overapproximation, not proof of execution or HTTP count.
Literal intent assignments include declarations; they are not necessarily request sites.
No browser or server execution; removable requests and performance benefit are NOT_VERIFIED.
